title: [WT-02] Daemon: worktree branch policy in complete_task, workspace in get_context
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.8 and §7.2.

Objective: make the two remaining daemon reads and checks honour the attempt's pinned workspace mode (WT-01, task-6cf120a38b344e72b7bab8b9faf806f1). A resumed session's wrapper reads the mode from get_context, and a worktree completion is checked against its own task branch.

Deliverable:
- tools/getContext.ts returns workspace: { mode, path, branch, target } from the task's open attempt. The shape is identical to WT-01's claim response. A task with no open attempt gets no field.
- tools/completeTask.ts checkBranchPolicy: when the owning attempt is workspaceMode 'worktree', currentBranch must equal moe/task/<taskId>; anything else fails with BRANCH-POLICY-FAIL naming that branch. A missing currentBranch keeps today's warning path. Shared-mode attempts keep today's consolidationBranch pattern check byte-for-byte.

NOT in scope: the claim side (WT-01); finalize_attempt (WT-03); wrappers; docs (WT-17).

Verification: cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build && npx vitest run src/tools/getContext.test.ts src/tools/completeTask.test.ts
definitionOfDone: getContext.test.ts: a task whose open attempt is worktree mode returns workspace {mode:'worktree', path, branch, target} equal to the claim's; a shared attempt returns mode 'shared'; no open attempt returns no workspace field.
completeTask.test.ts: a worktree attempt with currentBranch moe/task/<taskId> completes; any other branch is refused with BRANCH-POLICY-FAIL naming moe/task/<taskId>.
completeTask.test.ts: existing shared-mode branch-policy cases pass unchanged (no edits to their assertions).
The verification command in the description exits 0.
